name: usage-band
description: Responsive band above the prompt: context fill, 5h/7d rate limits, session tokens and cost

icons.title: Nerd Font icons
icons.description: Use Nerd Font glyphs (icons, rounded bar ends). Set the terminal font to a Nerd Font first, or they show as boxes.

hideStatus.title: Hide status lines
hideStatus.description: Clear every status line other plugins set ($.ui.status), so the bottom row shows only the mode labels. The band still shows the jev router status.
